method.title: Three phases. One trajectory. From first commit to first round.
method.paragraph: We don't teach theory. We embed directly into your founding team and run a structured cycle that turns uncertainty into traction — phase by phase.
method.step1.title: Structure & Diagnose
method.step1.body: We audit your current state: product, market, team, runway. No assumptions — we map what's actually working, what's leaking momentum, and what needs to be built or cut. You walk away with a single, prioritised plan.
method.step2.title: Execute & Traction
method.step2.body: Weekly execution cycles with real deliverables. Customer discovery, MVP iteration, unit economics. We hold the loop so you stay in motion — no more getting stuck on what to do next.
method.step3.title: Raise & Valorise
method.step3.body: When the traction is real, we prepare the narrative: data room, pitch deck, investor mapping, and dry runs. Our network opens doors — your metrics close them. You walk into rooms ready.

program.title: Admission by application.
program.paragraph: We work with a limited number of startups each cohort so the method stays tight. Tell us about your startup — if there's a fit, we'll run a diagnostic session at no cost.
program.note: No tiers. No self-serve. Just one programme designed to get you to your next milestone.
faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.q1: How is the Startuper.io programme different from an accelerator?
faq.a1: Accelerators take equity and run fixed curricula. We work on a cohort fee basis and adapt the method to your specific stage, product, and market. We don't batch you through generic workshops — we embed.
faq.q2: What is the time commitment per week?
faq.a2: Expect 4-6 hours of structured sessions per week (strategy reviews, execution sprints, investor prep) on top of your regular building work. The pace is intense by design — momentum compounds when you stay in the loop.
faq.q3: How do you select which startups to work with?
faq.a3: We look for three signals: a live problem with early validation (prototype, pre-revenue or revenue), a committed founding team, and a willingness to be accountable to a weekly rhythm. We turn down most applications because the fit has to be real on both sides.
faq.a4: Absolutely. We sign NDAs upfront. Your metrics, your deck, your strategy — nothing leaves the cohort without your explicit consent.
faq.q5: What happens after the programme ends?
faq.a5: Alumni get lifetime access to our founder network, preferential investor intros, and a reduced rate for follow-on diagnostics.
